privacyPolicy.intro: tidemail provides temporary email addresses for receiving and, when enabled, sending email. This policy explains the information handled to provide those features. Temporary inboxes are not private and are not suitable for sensitive, confidential, or time-critical information.
privacyPolicy.dataBody: You do not need to register an account. To receive email, we process the generated mailbox address and each message, including sender and recipient addresses, subject, headers, body, and timestamps. If you use mailbox recovery, we process the recovery password you submit to restore the mailbox address. If site password protection is enabled, we check the password you submit to unlock the site. When sending is available and you choose to send a message, we process the sender name, recipient address, subject, content, and reply address. For abuse prevention, we also process request and security data such as IP address, Turnstile verification signals when enabled, and per-minute mailbox/IP rate-limit counters.
privacyPolicy.useBody: We use this information to create and operate temporary mailboxes; receive, display, and delete messages; restore a mailbox address; send email when that feature is enabled; prevent abuse and enforce rate limits; and maintain the security and operation of the service.
privacyPolicy.mailboxPrivacyBody: Inbox retrieval is based on the mailbox address and does not require separate authentication for each mailbox. Anyone who knows a mailbox address can request its messages, and anyone who knows a message ID can request that message. A site password, if enabled, gates the website interface only; it does not make inbox messages private. Treat the address as public and do not use it for confidential communication, sensitive information, or account recovery. Removing a mailbox from this browser clears local cookies only; it does not delete messages from the server.
privacyPolicy.retentionBody: Incoming messages are stored in Cloudflare D1 and scheduled for deletion after seven days from receipt; the cleanup job runs hourly, so deletion may occur after that threshold. You can delete messages earlier from the inbox. Send-rate-limit counters use mailbox and IP identifiers and are scheduled for deletion after 24 hours. Clearing browser data or stopping use of a mailbox does not delete server-side messages. Cloudflare D1 recovery history may retain earlier database states after an active record is deleted, subject to Cloudflare's plan and configuration.
privacyPolicy.browserStorageBody: The browser stores the mailbox address, its displayed expiry time, and, when sending is enabled, a signed mailbox token in cookies for up to 24 hours. Resetting validity can renew the local expiry and sending token; it does not extend the seven-day server-side message-retention period. The site may store your language preference in a cookie or local storage and your theme preference in local storage. If site password protection is enabled, a Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie remembers the site unlock for 24 hours. Clearing cookies or local storage removes browser preferences and the saved mailbox address, but does not delete server-side messages.
privacyPolicy.providersBody: Cloudflare provides the Worker, database, and inbound email infrastructure. If enabled, Cloudflare Turnstile helps verify mailbox creation; its widget sends security signals to Cloudflare for verification. When outbound sending is enabled, the message fields you submit are sent to the delivery provider configured for the service, which may be Cloudflare, Resend, or MailChannels, and then to the recipient's email provider. Outgoing message content is not inserted into tidemail's D1 inbox table; delivery providers may process or retain it under their own terms and privacy practices.
privacyPolicy.securityBody: We use technical measures such as signed mailbox tokens and rate limits where configured. No internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed completely secure. Because mailbox reads are not individually authenticated, a temporary mailbox must not be treated as a secure or confidential account.
privacyPolicy.transfersBody: We do not sell email content. We share information with the providers needed to host the service, process inbound mail, verify requests, and deliver messages you choose to send, and when disclosure is required by law or needed to address abuse or protect rights. Provider infrastructure may process or store information outside your country; the exact Cloudflare D1 location depends on the deployed database configuration.
privacyPolicy.rightsBody: Depending on the laws that apply to you, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of information, or ask us to explain our handling of it. Email qa@naodeng.com.cn and include the mailbox address or message ID needed to identify the information, while sharing as little additional personal information as possible. We may need to verify a request and may be unable to recover information already deleted or no longer available.
privacyPolicy.childrenBody: The service is not directed to children, and we do not knowingly seek to collect children's personal information. Do not use the service if you are below the minimum age permitted by the laws that apply to you. If you believe a child has submitted personal information, contact us so we can review the request.
privacyPolicy.changesBody: We may update this policy when the service or its data practices change. We will publish the revised policy and update the date below. Where applicable law requires additional notice or consent, we will follow that requirement.
privacyPolicy.contactBody: For questions or privacy requests, contact the tidemail service team at qa@naodeng.com.cn.

termsOfService.intro: These Terms govern your use of tidemail. By using the service, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
termsOfService.descriptionBody: tidemail lets you create a temporary email address on an available domain, receive, view, and delete messages, and recover the mailbox address with a recovery password. Outbound email is available only when enabled by the operator. No account registration is required. The service is temporary and is not a private or permanent mailbox.
termsOfService.availabilityBody: Features, domains, and delivery may change or be unavailable, and availability can vary by region and provider. You are responsible for using the service in compliance with the laws and provider rules that apply to you.
termsOfService.copyrightBody: The tidemail name, interface, and service materials are protected by the rights of their respective owners; do not reproduce them without permission. You retain rights in messages you submit, and authorize the limited processing, storage, display, and transmission needed to operate the features you use.
termsOfService.registrationBody: No account registration is required. You are responsible for keeping your mailbox address and recovery password under your control. The recovery password restores the address; it does not provide private inbox authentication.
termsOfService.mailboxAccessBody: Anyone who knows a mailbox address can request messages for it, and anyone who knows a message ID can request that message. A site password, if enabled, protects access to the website interface only. Do not use tidemail for confidential communication, sensitive data, financial or health services, or as the sole recovery address for important accounts.
termsOfService.prohibitedActivitiesBody: You must not use the service to violate applicable law, harm others, interfere with the service, or evade its limits. Prohibited activities include:
termsOfService.prohibitedActivityOne: Sending spam or unsolicited messages, or contacting recipients without required authorization.
termsOfService.prohibitedActivityTwo: Phishing, fraud, impersonation, harassment, or sending unlawful or rights-infringing content.
termsOfService.prohibitedActivityThree: Sending malware or harmful code, disrupting the service, or attempting unauthorized access.
termsOfService.prohibitedActivityFour: Evading rate limits or abusing the service or its providers.
termsOfService.emailSendingBody: If sending is enabled, you authorize tidemail to transmit the sender name, reply address, recipient address, subject, and content you submit to the configured email provider and recipient. You must have the right to send the message and must follow applicable anti-spam and privacy laws. The provider or recipient system may reject, delay, or retain a message under its own rules. Sending may be rate-limited or disabled to protect the service.
termsOfService.warrantyBody: The service is provided on an as-is and as-available basis. We do not guarantee uninterrupted service, delivery, message availability, or error-free operation. Do not rely on tidemail for urgent or time-critical communications.
termsOfService.liabilityBody: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, tidemail and its operator are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the service. Nothing in these Terms excludes liability or rights that cannot legally be excluded or limited.
termsOfService.modificationBody: We may update these Terms to reflect changes to the service or applicable requirements. We will publish the revised Terms and date below; changes take effect on the stated date. Where applicable law requires notice or consent, we will follow that requirement.
termsOfService.governingLawBody: These Terms are subject to the laws that apply to you and the service operator. Disputes will be handled by a court with jurisdiction under those laws. This section does not remove mandatory rights or protections available to you under applicable law.
termsOfService.contactBody: For questions about these Terms, contact the tidemail service team at qa@naodeng.com.cn.
